meeting_notes:
The portal must support mobile devices.
Build a customer dashboard.
Confirm which users can access reports?

The system should load quickly.
Create a weekly reporting feature.
The launch date is unknown.

Users need secure login.
Develop a password reset page.
Decide the session timeout.

The app must support two languages.
Design an onboarding screen.
The data migration plan is TBD.

The service shall store audit logs.
Implement an export feature.
Confirm the retention period.

The dashboard needs a search filter.
Build a search interface.
Which fields should be searchable?

The report must support PDF downloads.
Create a PDF export tool.
The final file format is unclear.

The site should meet accessibility needs.
Design accessible navigation.
Decide which accessibility standard to follow.

The platform must support 500 users.
Develop a load testing script.
The peak traffic target is not sure yet.

The app needs email notifications.
Implement notification settings.
Confirm the email provider.

The system must record failed logins.
Create an admin audit page.
How long should logs be kept?

The checkout should show shipping costs.
Build a checkout summary.
The tax calculation rules are unclear.

The service must support backups.
Create a backup status page.
Decide the backup schedule.

The search should return relevant results.
Develop a search results page.
Which ranking method will be used?

The customer needs order history.
Design an order history screen.
Confirm how many months to display.

The API must validate incoming data.
Implement request validation.
The error response format is TBD.

The admin needs a user activity summary.
Build an activity report.
Should the report include archived users?

The mobile app must cache recent content.
Develop offline support.
Decide how long cached data remains.

The system should send a reminder before expiry.
Create a reminder email template.
The reminder timing is unknown.

The application must protect customer information.
Design a privacy settings page.
Confirm who can change these settings.
